portal_description:
Perl is a high-level programming language that is commonly used for system administration utilities and web programming. The rh-perl526 packages provide a recent stable release of Perl with a number of additional utilities, scripts, and database connectors for MySQL and PostgreSQL.

This enhancement update adds the rh-perl526 packages to Red Hat Software Collections. (BZ#1518818)

For details, see the Red Hat Software Collections 3.1 Release Notes linked from the References section.

All users who require rh-perl526 are advised to install these new packages.
